title: Writing posts for this blog
description: Every post is one JSON file. Add a file, push, and the post appears with its own share preview.

blocks.text: There's no CMS and no database. Each post is a single file in `public/content/posts/`, named after its slug.

items: `list` — bullet list, or numbered with `"ordered": true`

blocks.title: No cover? No problem
blocks.text: Leave out `cover` and the build draws a preview image from the title, tags and `accent` colour.
Set `"draft": true` to keep a post out of the list and the build until it's ready.
